1. For reference patches of 8 x 8 every 3 pixels, find up to 16 similar patches in the search window.
2. Stack them, take the 3D DCT, set small coefficients to 0, and transform back.
3. Average all patch estimates into the basic estimate, weighting groups by how few coefficients they kept.
4. Match again on the basic estimate, up to 32 patches, and stack the noisy and the basic patches.
5. Scale the noisy group by the Wiener coefficients from the basic group, and transform back.
6. Average all patch estimates into the final estimate.
